title: Algebra 1 Foundations | Pre-Algebra Review Bundle
description: Review fundamental Pre-Algebra skills at the beginning of the school year before tackling Algebra 1! Includes 5 differentiated riddle worksheet sets and 3 classroom anchor chart posters.
